# 💡 StreamTower Feature Request

Have an idea that could make StreamTower better?

Feature suggestions are welcome — whether it's a completely new tool or an improvement to something already in StreamTower.

## 🎯 What Problem Would This Solve?

Tell us why this feature would be useful.

For example:

- Saves time during a stream
- Reduces the number of programs a streamer needs
- Makes Twitch management easier
- Improves OBS integration
- Helps with raids or shoutouts
- Improves viewer/community interaction
- Automates something currently done manually
